title: Stage 2 — HTML & CSS
goal: Build a responsive static app shell with semantic HTML, flexbox, and CSS variables.
summary: DevTools first, then structure and layout. A real-looking shell on desktop and mobile — no JavaScript yet.

checkpoint.prompt: You tweak CSS in DevTools and the page updates, but refresh loses the change. Why?

choices.text: DevTools edits are temporary — source files in your repo are the truth
Chrome blocks CSS on refresh
HTML files cannot load stylesheets

checkpoint.explanation: Live edits prove a fix works. Copy the working rule into styles.css and commit it.

checkpoint.prompt: Which element should wrap the primary content of the page (one per page)?

choices.text: <main>
<div class="main">
<header>

checkpoint.explanation: <main> is the semantic region for primary content. <header> is for top bars; divs carry no meaning.

steps.title: Lay out a header with flex

checkpoint.prompt: Which CSS property makes flex items line up in a row by default on the main axis?
checkpoint.explanation: `display: flex` creates the container; `flex-direction: row` (the default) lays children out horizontally.

checkpoint.prompt: You want one accent color used by buttons, links, and borders. Best approach?

choices.text: Define --color-accent on :root and reference var(--color-accent) in rules
Copy the same hex into every selector
Use inline style on each element

checkpoint.explanation: CSS variables on :root give a single source of truth for the theme.

choices.text: Default styles target narrow screens; min-width media queries enhance for wider viewports
You write a separate HTML file for phones
JavaScript detects the device and loads different CSS

checkpoint.explanation: Start simple for small viewports, then use @media (min-width: …) to add layout complexity as space grows.

checklist.label: Semantic HTML shell (header, main, nav, footer)
Flexbox layout for header and main content area
CSS variables on :root used across styles
At least one responsive breakpoint (mobile + desktop OK)
Layout validated in DevTools Elements at ~375px and desktop width

questions.prompt: Spacing looks wrong on a card. Which DevTools panel do you use first?

choices.text: Elements — select the node and inspect box model / flex overlay
Network — inspect HTTP headers
Application — inspect localStorage

questions.explanation: Elements shows DOM structure, applied CSS, and the box model for layout debugging.

choices.text: Associates the label with the input — correct structure and a larger click target
Required for CSS flexbox to work
Git needs matching ids to commit forms

questions.explanation: Labels tied to inputs are correct semantic form structure.

questions.prompt: In a row flex container, justify-content aligns items along…

choices.text: The main axis (horizontal for flex-direction: row)
The cross axis only
The z-index stack

questions.explanation: justify-content distributes along the main axis; align-items handles the cross axis.

questions.prompt: How do you use a custom property --color-accent in a rule?

choices.text: color: var(--color-accent);
color: --color-accent;
color: $color-accent;

questions.explanation: Custom properties are referenced with var(--name), optionally with a fallback.

questions.prompt: What does <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" /> do?

choices.text: Tells mobile browsers to use the device width so your CSS layout applies correctly
Loads a second CSS file for phones
Enables JavaScript in the head

questions.explanation: Without viewport meta, mobile browsers assume a desktop-width page and shrink it.
